item.text: {"schema_version":"script-1.0","script":"A confident answer can still be wrong. Before you trust a claim, follow it back to its source. Check what the original actually says, not just the summary. If the evidence is missing, leave the gap visible instead of filling it with a guess. Then make your decision. Useful AI should help you understand the answer—not just make it sound convincing.","audience":"People who use AI for work, research, and everyday decisions.","style":"reference-expressive-v1","rationale":"A compact paper investigation makes support relationships tangible: the bot opens, traces, compares, and cautiously files each layer. One conspicuous empty connector remains unresolved, so the payoff is a readable understanding of the claim’s limits rather than a verdict.","metaphor":"An answer is a folded paper structure whose strength and meaning depend on visible connections to its source and evidence.","assets":[{"id":"bot","description":"Canonical Motif bot; active investigator handling every paper object.","reuse_path":"assets/characters/motif-bot/canonical/v1/motif-bot-v1.json"},{"id":"desk","description":"Neutral tabletop providing both contextual wide views and close inspection space.","reuse_path":"assets/scenes/scene-01/furniture/desk.svg"},{"id":"project-folio-kit","description":"Existing tactile folio used to contain and organize the investigation layers.","reuse_path":"assets/scenes/book-workshop/project-folio-kit.svg"},{"id":"source-chain-paper-set","description":"New finite artwork: a glossy folded SAMPLE answer card, a SAMPLE summary flap, a SAMPLE original-source leaf, connector strips, and a small decision bookmark.","reuse_path":""},{"id":"missing-evidence-frame","description":"New finite artwork: an open paper frame with two unmatched tabs, visibly incapable of completing the evidence connection.","reuse_path":""}],"beats":[{"id":"beat-01","narration":"A confident answer can still be wrong.","subject":"A glossy folded SAMPLE answer card and the bot.","action":"The bot snaps the card upright; its unsupported base immediately buckles and the card pitches forward into the bot’s hands.","before_after":"Before: a crisp, imposing answer stands tall. After: the same answer is visibly unstable and caught before it falls flat.","focal_detail":"The collapsing base fold beneath the readable SAMPLE answer card.","consequence":"Surface polish is separated from structural support in the opening seconds.","headline":"Looks can stand tall","focus_target":"Unsupported base fold of the SAMPLE answer card","framing":"detail","actions":[{"kind":"snap-open-then-buckle-sample-answer","cue":"A confident answer","requires":["The SAMPLE answer card begins folded flat on the desk","The card has a crisp display fold but no supporting connector beneath it","The bot has both hands free"],"produces":["The SAMPLE answer card briefly stands upright","The unsupported base visibly buckles","The bot catches the falling card"]}],"needed_assets":["bot","desk","source-chain-paper-set"]},{"id":"beat-02","narration":"Before you trust a claim, follow it back to its source.","subject":"The bot, the SAMPLE answer card, and a paper connector entering the folio.","action":"The bot turns the fallen card over, finds a narrow connector strip on its back, and pulls it through successive folio slots until a source leaf begins to emerge.","before_after":"Before: the answer’s origin is hidden. After: a continuous physical route leads from the answer into the opened folio.","focal_detail":"The connector strip traveling through aligned paper slots while remaining attached to the answer.","consequence":"The claim gains traceable provenance, but no truth judgment is made.","headline":"Trace the route","focus_target":"Connector strip linking the answer card to the folio","framing":"subject","actions":[{"kind":"trace-claim-connector-through-folio","cue":"Before you trust a claim","requires":["The bot holds the buckled SAMPLE answer card","A connector strip is attached to the card’s reverse","The project folio is closed beside the card"],"produces":["The folio opens","The connector passes through visible folio slots","A SAMPLE original-source leaf becomes partially exposed"]}],"needed_assets":["bot","desk","project-folio-kit","source-chain-paper-set"]},{"id":"beat-03","narration":"Check what the original actually says, not just the summary.","subject":"The bot comparing a SAMPLE summary flap with its SAMPLE original-source leaf.","action":"The bot lifts the short summary flap like a window, revealing the longer original wording underneath; one overstated word on the flap no longer aligns with the qualified phrase below.","before_after":"Before: the summary covers the source and appears sufficient. After: both layers are simultaneously readable, with their wording difference physically registered by misaligned cutouts.","focal_detail":"A summary cutout around “WILL” sitting above the original phrase “MAY,” with SAMPLE printed on both layers.","consequence":"The viewer can see exactly where compression changed the claim while understanding that locating an original is not proof by itself.","headline":"Read beneath it","focus_target":"Misaligned WILL/MAY wording window across the two SAMPLE layers","framing":"detail","actions":[{"kind":"lift-summary-window-to-compare-source","cue":"Check what the original","requires":["The SAMPLE summary flap covers the SAMPLE original-source leaf","The two layers are attached along one paper hinge","Their differing words occupy the same viewing window"],"produces":["The bot exposes both wordings in one close view","The summary’s overstatement becomes visibly attributable to its own layer","The original-source leaf remains connected but unverified"]}],"needed_assets":["bot","source-chain-paper-set"]},{"id":"beat-04","narration":"If the evidence is missing, leave the gap visible instead of filling it with a guess.","subject":"The bot, the source leaf, two unmatched connector ends, and an empty evidence frame.","action":"The bot draws the source connector toward the evidence frame, discovers the strip is too short, removes a tempting blank scrap from the gap, and parks that scrap outside the chain.","before_after":"Before: a loose scrap could conceal the missing connection. After: open desk surface remains clearly visible between the unmatched tabs.","focal_detail":"The uncovered air gap between the source strip and empty evidence frame.","consequence":"Missing support stays legible and explicitly unowned; no invented bridge enters the chain.","headline":"Keep the gap open","focus_target":"Open space between unmatched source and evidence tabs","framing":"detail","actions":[{"kind":"expose-and-preserve-evidence-gap","cue":"If the evidence is missing","requires":["The SAMPLE original-source leaf has a connector strip","The evidence frame has an unmatched receiving tab","A loose blank scrap rests near the gap"],"produces":["The connector ends remain physically separated","The bot relocates the blank scrap outside the support chain","The missing evidence gap stays unobstructed"]}],"needed_assets":["bot","desk","source-chain-paper-set","missing-evidence-frame"]},{"id":"beat-05","narration":"Then make your decision.","subject":"The bot and a small paper decision bookmark beside the unresolved chain.","action":"The bot folds the bookmark into a shallow standing tab and places it beside the source layer, deliberately outside the missing gap and without covering any wording.","before_after":"Before: no decision object is present. After: a modest “Needs review” bookmark records the next step while leaving every source layer and the gap exposed.","focal_detail":"The bookmark’s foot positioned beside—not across—the broken connection.","consequence":"A decision can proceed with visible limits instead of pretending the evidence chain is complete.","headline":"Decide with limits","focus_target":"Decision bookmark placed adjacent to the unresolved evidence gap","framing":"subject","actions":[{"kind":"place-cautious-decision-bookmark","cue":"Then make your decision","requires":["The answer, summary, source, and missing gap are all visible","The decision bookmark begins flat in the bot’s hand","The gap must remain unobstructed"],"produces":["The “Needs review” bookmark stands beside the chain","No source wording is covered","The missing evidence gap remains unchanged"]}],"needed_assets":["bot","desk","source-chain-paper-set","missing-evidence-frame"]},{"id":"beat-06","narration":"Useful AI should help you understand the answer—not just make it sound convincing.","subject":"The bot and the complete exploded paper chain from answer to unresolved evidence frame.","action":"The bot slides the layers into a clear stepped arrangement, opens the source leaf fully, and rests one hand beside the exact wording difference while the other points back along the connector to the still-empty gap.","before_after":"Before: the investigation layers are locally readable but scattered. After: answer, summary, original, decision bookmark, and missing support form one phone-readable causal view.","focal_detail":"The visible route from polished answer to altered summary wording, original wording, and the persistent open gap.","consequence":"The closing image delivers comprehension of what is known, changed, and missing without resolving or celebrating the claim.","headline":"See how it holds","focus_target":"Stepped paper chain with wording comparison and unresolved evidence gap","framing":"establish","actions":[{"kind":"arrange-exploded-support-chain-for-understanding","cue":"Useful AI should help","requires":["All investigation layers remain on the desk","The original-source leaf can open flat","The missing evidence tabs remain unmatched"],"produces":["Every layer and ownership relationship is readable in one composition","The bot connects the wording comparison to the support path through gesture","The evidence gap remains visibly unresolved in the final frame"]}],"needed_assets":["bot","desk","project-folio-kit","source-chain-paper-set","missing-evidence-frame"]}],"ending_action":"Hold on the bot calmly tracing the complete paper route from SAMPLE answer to SAMPLE original, then stopping its fingertip at the uncovered evidence gap while all layers remain readable.","limitations":["All fictional answer, summary, and source text must carry a clearly readable SAMPLE mark.","The original-source leaf is treated as traceable context, never automatic proof.","The evidence gap must remain open and visible through the final frame.","No checkmarks, approval verdicts, celebratory gestures, trophies, or sales CTA.","New artwork is limited to the finite source-chain paper set and missing-evidence frame; their actions require explicit agent-assisted development."]}
